title: Alternative look-elsewhere treatments for the LZ model scan: Bonferroni, Sidak, Gross-Vitells upcrossings, the Bayesian trials factor and the pre-registration counterfactual
question: How does the global significance of LZ's 3.4 sigma event depend on the LEE method (Bonferroni/Sidak, eigenvalue M_eff, Gross-Vitells with toy-counted upcrossings in calibrated and asymptotic metrics, Bayesian trials factor) and on the search-space definition (pre-registration counterfactuals; the corpus's ~200 added spectra), and how do N_eff and the LEE cost scale with the local threshold up to 5 sigma?
headline_result: Only toy min-p reproduces LZ's correction: N_eff = 14.2 +- 1.1 at 3.4 sigma (2.59 sigma global) after removing a 12% finite-calibration bias; Bonferroni (1.29 sigma), eigenvalue estimators (3-444 trials) and Gross-Vitells (-45% to +30%) fail; a 6- or 30-spectrum pre-registration would give 3.1-3.3 or 2.85 sigma; the corpus's added spectra lower the honest global significance to 2.50 sigma; the LEE cost stays 0.7-0.8 sigma from 2 to 5 sigma local
key_numbers: N_eff@3.4: raw 15.9 (50k), 20.6 (6.25k), debiased 14.2+-1.1+-0.7 -> 2.59 sigma; 4.87/6.12/9.01 at 2.0/2.5/3.0; Bonferroni 293/616 1.29/0.81 sigma, Sidak 293 1.32; exceedance cluster 33 spectra at 3.4 sigma (95 at 2); eigenvalue M_eff 3-444, participation ratio on tail indicators 4.4/5.7/7.5 vs toys 3.9/5.4/10.6; GV calibrated 1D 5.0-7.3 vs 10.1, 2D 13.8 vs 10.8, N_up e^(c0^2/2) 0.48-0.54 (c0<=2.5), 0.69 (3.0); N_eff ~ Z^1.8, cost 0.72-0.81 sigma (2-3.4), at 5 sigma N_eff 24-39 cost 0.65-0.76; counterfactuals 1 model 3.45, 6 spectra 3.09-3.29, 30 spectra 2.85, heavy elastic 2.96, inelastic grid 2.69, LZ-like 2.59; corpus 654 spectra N_eff 18.7 (x1.32) -> 2.50 sigma (2.50-2.55 on LZ/P008 baselines); Bayesian 10.3 -> 2.70 sigma, M/29 vs M/32 structure; SBB bound 13.2
model_or_mechanism: P008 1D extended likelihood and toy-calibrated min-p; disjoint sub-sample extrapolation of the finite-calibration bias; Bonferroni/Sidak; Nyholt-Cheverud, Li-Ji, participation-ratio, Galwey, Gao eigenvalue estimators; Gross-Vitells 1D upcrossings and 2D Euler characteristics counted in toys; power-law/exponential/GV-form fits of N_eff(Z); corpus variants: light-mediator propagator, isospin ratios, halo/date variants, continuous delta scan
stance: statistical reassessment (weakens slightly: 2.50 sigma after community reinterpretation; confirms LZ's 2.6 sigma for its own space)
